name: Prototype Sky Striker Ace - Noir
effect:
2+ monsters, including at least 1 "Sky Striker" monster.
You can only Special Summon 1 “Sky Striker Ace – Prototype Noir” per turn.
The following effect is only applied the first time you Special Summon "Prototype Sky Striker Ace - Noir" per Duel from your extra deck.
■ It becomes unaffected by other card effects until the end of your next turn.
This card can attack all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls, once each.
When this card declares an attack, your opponnent cannot activate card or effects.
This card gains 200 ATK for each "Sky Striker" card in your GY.
